title: Transformer limited to text modality
description: The Transformer is currently designed and evaluated only on text-based tasks (machine translation, parsing). The authors explicitly plan to extend it to other modalities.
canonical_description: attention-based model limited to text modality

evidence.quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
